spans.s:
दण्ड (त, क) दण्डयति 10.
a. To punish.

दाण्ड (ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
a. Relating to a
stick or to punishment.

दण्डक (कः-कं) 1.
m. n. A metre; a ves-
sel.
f. (का) Peninsula of India.

दण्डका_रण्य (ण्यं) 1.
n. The peninsula.

दण्ड-ग्रहण (णं) 1.
n. Becoming a
mendicant or ascetic.

दण्ड-घ्न (घ्नः) 1.
m. A fighter with sticks.

दण्ड-जित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Subdued or
suppressed by punishment.

दण्ड-ढक्का (क्का) 1.
f. A sort of drum.

दण्ड-ताम्री (म्री) 3.
f. A perforated
copper vessel, used for marking
time by its gradually filling.

दण्ड-दास (सः) 1.
m. A slave for debt.

दण्ड-धर (रः) 1.
m. A name of
Yama;
a king; a potter; a mendicant.
a. Having a rod, staff or sceptre^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

दण्ड-धारण (णं) 1.
n. Becoming an
ascetic; punishment.

दण्ड-न (नं) 1.
n. Punishing.

दण्ड-नायक (कः) 1.
m. A general; a
leader; police officer.

दण्ड-नीति (तिः) 2.
f. Polity; discipline.

दण्डनीय (यः-या-यं)
a. Punishable.

दण्ड-नेतृत्व (त्वं) 1.
n. Infliction of
punishment; ruling.

दण्डनीय-त्व (त्वं) 1.
n. Demerit.

दण्डपांशुल (लः) 1.
m. A porter.

दण्ड-पाणि (णिः) 2.
m. Yama; a staff-
bearer; attendant on
Shiva.

दण्ड-पातिन् (ती-तिनी-ति)
a. Fining,
punishing, awarding.

दण्ड-पारुष्य (ष्यं) 1.
n. Assault; inflic-
tion of cruel punishment.

दण्ड-पाल (लः) 1.
m. A small kind
of fish; a door-keeper.

दण्ड-पालक (कः) 1.
m. Idem.

दण्ड-पाशिक (कः) 1.
m. An execu-
tioner, a hangman.

दण्ड-प्रणयन (नं) 1.
n. Punishing.

दण्ड-भीति (तिः) 2.
f. Fear of pu-
nishment; servile fear.

दण्ड-भृत् (त्) 5.
m. A potter.

दण्ड-मानव (वः) 1.
m. An ascetic.

दण्ड-यात्रा (त्रा) 1.
f. Subjection of
a country; bridal procession.

दण्ड-याम (मः) 1.
m. A name of
Yama
and
Agustya; a day.

दण्ड-योग (गं) 1.
n. Punishing.

दण्ड-लेश (शं) 1.
n. Small fine.
adv. Prostrate.

दण्डवत् (वान्-वती-वत्)
a. Having a
stick, carrying a staff.

दण्ड-वादिन् (दी) 5.
m. A door-keep-
er; a mace-bearer; a threatener.

दण्ड-वालधि (धिः) 2.
m. An elephant.

दण्ड-वासिन् (सी) 5.
m. A door-keep-
er; a magistrate of a village.

दण्ड-विकल्प (ल्पः) 1.
m. Fit punish-
ment, just sentence.

दण्ड-विधि (धिः) 2.
f. Criminal law.

दण्ड-विशेष (षः) 1.
m. A kind or de-
gree of punishment.

दण्ड-विष्कम्भ (म्भः) 1.
m. A post or a
stake used in churning.

दण्ड-हस्त (स्तः) 1.
m. A staff-bearer;
door-keeper.
n. Name of a tree.

दण्डा_जिन (नं) 1.
n. Deceit.

दण्डा_दण्डि
adv. Single stick; cud-
gelling, fighting with sticks.

दण्डार (रः) 1.
m. A carriage; a pot-
ter's wheel; a bow; elephant in
rut; furious elephant.

दण्डा_हत (तः) 1.
m. Butter-milk.

दण्डिका (का) 1.
f. A necklace, a string.

दण्डित (तः)
a. Punished, fined.

दण्डो_त्पला (ला) 1.
f. A small shrub.

दण्ड्य (ण्ड्यः-ण्ड्या-ण्ड्यं)
a. Punishable.

दाण्डमाथिक (कः-की-कं)
a. Churning.

दाण्डाजिनिक (कः-का-कं)
a. Fraudulent.
